   - 50%: KL=12.00 vs TEAL=23.31 (gap=11.31)
   直观展示 gap 随 sparsity 增大。

3. fig3 PASS，无需改动。

修完后重新生成 fig2 PDF 并汇报。

Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".

- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). #!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate fig2_sparsity_sweep: PPL vs Sparsity for KL Predictor, Vanilla TEAL, WINA."""

import json
import pathlib
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as ticker
import numpy as np

HERE = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DATA_PATH = HERE / "fig2_data.json"
OUT_PDF = HERE / "fig2_sparsity_sweep.pdf"
OUT_PNG = HERE / "fig2_sparsity_sweep.png"

with open(DATA_PATH) as f:
    data = json.load(f)

sparsity = data["sparsity"]
dense_ppl = data["dense_baseline"]
methods = data["methods"]

plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.serif": ["Times New Roman", "DejaVu Serif"],
    "font.size": 11,
    "axes.labelsize": 12,
    "axes.titlesize": 13,
    "legend.fontsize": 10,
    "xtick.labelsize": 10,
    "ytick.labelsize": 10,
    "mathtext.fontset": "stix",
    "figure.dpi": 300,
    "savefig.dpi": 300,
    "savefig.bbox": "tight",
    "savefig.pad_inches": 0.05,
})

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.0, 3.8))

ax.set_yscale("log")

ax.axhline(y=dense_ppl, color="grey", linestyle="--", linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.7, zorder=1)
ax.text(sparsity[0] - 1.5, dense_ppl * 0.88, f"Dense ({dense_ppl})",
        fontsize=9, color="grey", ha="left", va="top")

for name, m in methods.items():
    ax.plot(sparsity, m["ppl"],
            color=m["color"], linestyle=m["linestyle"], marker=m["marker"],
            markersize=7, linewidth=2.0, label=m["label"], zorder=3)

# Annotate 70% sparsity gap
kl_70 = methods["KL Predictor"]["ppl"][2]
teal_70 = methods["Vanilla TEAL"]["ppl"][2]
wina_70 = methods["WINA"]["ppl"][2]

ax.annotate(f"{kl_70:.1f}",
            xy=(70, kl_70), xytext=(72.5, kl_70 * 0.72),
            fontsize=8.5, color=methods["KL Predictor"]["color"], fontweight="bold",
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-", color=methods["KL Predictor"]["color"],
                            lw=0.8, alpha=0.6),
            ha="left", va="center")

ax.annotate(f"{teal_70:.1f}",
            xy=(70, teal_70), xytext=(72.5, teal_70),
            fontsize=8.5, color=methods["Vanilla TEAL"]["color"], fontweight="bold",
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-", color=methods["Vanilla TEAL"]["color"],
                            lw=0.8, alpha=0.6),
            ha="left", va="center")

ax.annotate(f"{wina_70:.1f}",
            xy=(70, wina_70), xytext=(72.5, wina_70 * 1.15),
            fontsize=8.5, color=methods["WINA"]["color"], fontweight="bold",
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-", color=methods["WINA"]["color"],
                            lw=0.8, alpha=0.6),
            ha="left", va="center")

# Bracket showing gap at 70%
bracket_x = 68.2
ax.annotate("", xy=(bracket_x, kl_70), xytext=(bracket_x, wina_70),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="<->", color="#555555", lw=1.2))
gap_mid = np.sqrt(kl_70 * wina_70)
ax.text(bracket_x - 1.5, gap_mid, f"{wina_70/kl_70:.1f}×",
        fontsize=9, color="#555555", ha="right", va="center", fontweight="bold")

ax.set_xlabel("Sparsity (%)")
ax.set_ylabel("Perplexity (log scale)")
ax.set_xticks(sparsity)
ax.set_xticklabels([f"{s:.0f}%" if s == int(s) else f"{s}%" for s in sparsity])
ax.set_xlim(22, 80)

ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(ticker.ScalarFormatter())
ax.yaxis.set_minor_formatter(ticker.NullFormatter())
ax.set_yticks([6, 10, 20, 50, 100, 140])
ax.get_yaxis().set_major_formatter(ticker.ScalarFormatter())
ax.ticklabel_format(axis="y", style="plain")

ax.legend(loc="upper left", frameon=True, fancybox=False, edgecolor="#cccccc",
          framealpha=0.95)

ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25, which="major")

fig.savefig(OUT_PDF, format="pdf")
fig.savefig(OUT_PNG, format="png")
plt.close(fig)

print(f"Saved: {OUT_PDF}")
print(f"Saved: {OUT_PNG}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate fig2_sparsity_sweep: PPL vs Sparsity for KL Predictor, Vanilla TEAL, WINA."""

import json
import pathlib
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as ticker
import numpy as np

HERE = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DATA_PATH = HERE / "fig2_data.json"
OUT_PDF = HERE / "fig2_sparsity_sweep.pdf"
OUT_PNG = HERE / "fig2_sparsity_sweep.png"

with open(DATA_PATH) as f:
    data = json.load(f)

sparsity = data["sparsity"]
dense_ppl = data["dense_baseline"]
methods = data["methods"]

plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.serif": ["Times New Roman", "DejaVu Serif"],
    "font.size": 11,
    "axes.labelsize": 12,
    "axes.titlesize": 13,
    "legend.fontsize": 10,
    "xtick.labelsize": 10,
    "ytick.labelsize": 10,
    "mathtext.fontset": "stix",
    "figure.dpi": 300,
    "savefig.dpi": 300,
    "savefig.bbox": "tight",
    "savefig.pad_inches": 0.05,
})

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.0, 3.8))

ax.set_yscale("log")

ax.axhline(y=dense_ppl, color="grey", linestyle="--", linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.7, zorder=1)
ax.text(sparsity[0] - 1.5, dense_ppl * 0.88, f"Dense ({dense_ppl})",
        fontsize=9, color="grey", ha="left", va="top")

for name, m in methods.items():
    ax.plot(sparsity, m["ppl"],
            color=m["color"], linestyle=m["linestyle"], marker=m["marker"],
            markersize=7, linewidth=2.0, label=m["label"], zorder=3)

# Annotate 70% sparsity gap
kl_70 = methods["KL Predictor"]["ppl"][2]
teal_70 = methods["Vanilla TEAL"]["ppl"][2]
wina_70 = methods["WINA"]["ppl"][2]

ax.annotate(f"{kl_70:.1f}",
            xy=(70, kl_70), xytext=(72.5, kl_70 * 0.72),
            fontsize=8.5, color=methods["KL Predictor"]["color"], fontweight="bold",
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-", color=methods["KL Predictor"]["color"],
                            lw=0.8, alpha=0.6),
            ha="left", va="center")

ax.annotate(f"{teal_70:.1f}",
            xy=(70, teal_70), xytext=(72.5, teal_70),
            fontsize=8.5, color=methods["Vanilla TEAL"]["color"], fontweight="bold",
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-", color=methods["Vanilla TEAL"]["color"],
                            lw=0.8, alpha=0.6),
            ha="left", va="center")

ax.annotate(f"{wina_70:.1f}",
            xy=(70, wina_70), xytext=(72.5, wina_70 * 1.15),
            fontsize=8.5, color=methods["WINA"]["color"], fontweight="bold",
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-", color=methods["WINA"]["color"],
                            lw=0.8, alpha=0.6),
            ha="left", va="center")

# Bracket showing gap at 70%
bracket_x = 68.2
ax.annotate("", xy=(bracket_x, kl_70), xytext=(bracket_x, wina_70),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="<->", color="#555555", lw=1.2))
gap_mid = np.sqrt(kl_70 * wina_70)
ax.text(bracket_x - 1.5, gap_mid, f"{wina_70/kl_70:.1f}×",
        fontsize=9, color="#555555", ha="right", va="center", fontweight="bold")

ax.set_xlabel("Sparsity (%)")
ax.set_ylabel("Perplexity (log scale)")
ax.set_xticks(sparsity)
ax.set_xticklabels([f"{s:.0f}%" if s == int(s) else f"{s}%" for s in sparsity])
ax.set_xlim(22, 80)

ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(ticker.ScalarFormatter())
ax.yaxis.set_minor_formatter(ticker.NullFormatter())
ax.set_yticks([6, 10, 20, 50, 100, 140])
ax.get_yaxis().set_major_formatter(ticker.ScalarFormatter())
ax.ticklabel_format(axis="y", style="plain")

ax.legend(loc="upper left", frameon=True, fancybox=False, edgecolor="#cccccc",
          framealpha=0.95)

ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25, which="major")

fig.savefig(OUT_PDF, format="pdf")
fig.savefig(OUT_PNG, format="png")
plt.close(fig)

print(f"Saved: {OUT_PDF}")
print(f"Saved: {OUT_PNG}")
